payload.detail:
CURRENT CORRECTION 24 October 2026: The duplicate admin home is gone: be1315b8b3 removed src/app/mockups/development/** and repointed links to /admin/developer-hub under the recorded owner decision. The early PWA prompt hydration fix is also implemented (90b9f697e9), so do not rebuild that fix. It does not prove password-reset/privacy-route acceptance: retain targeted browser verification, settings/approval-gate concerns, thin browser journeys and remaining legacy naming. The local organisation map now covers the 44 previously unplaced tracked files and the docs pipeline passes; this does not close all residuals.

HISTORICAL DETAIL (superseded where corrected above): Settings changes in GitHub are the owner's. Browser-check L4A-F2 before changing anything. HYSWAF already tracks Railway deploying before checks finish (L6-F1).
